title: Attendance
subtitle: Staff clock-ins and clock-outs. They are recorded on the venue terminal or app; here you review them.

empty.title: No clock-ins in this period
empty.description: Staff clock in and out from the venue terminal or app.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this clock-in?
rejectDialog.description: Say why you are rejecting {{name}}'s entry. The reason is saved.
rejectDialog.placeholder: e.g. the photo is not from this location

toasts.errorDesc: Please try again in a moment.

empty.title: Nothing to report for this period
empty.description: People with a schedule who were late, absent or left early show up here. Without a schedule nobody is judged.

disabled.title: Attendance tracking is off
disabled.description: Staff cannot clock in while it is off. What was already recorded stays here.

loadError.title: Could not load
loadError.description: Something went wrong fetching this data. It does not mean there is nothing to show.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Period numbers, payroll-ready. Vacation and leave are not absences.
payroll.empty: No staff activity in this period.

overtime.violationHelp: A week breaks article 66 of the Mexican Federal Labour Law: over 3 overtime hours in one day, or overtime on more than 3 days. Pay is unchanged, but it is a violation.

approve.title: {{name}}'s overtime
approve.help: Approve day by day. You can approve less than the clock recorded, but never more. Only approved time is paid at double or triple rate.
approve.invalid: Enter a whole number of minutes.
approve.tooMuch: You cannot approve more than {{max}} minutes: that is what the clock recorded.
approve.conflict: Someone else changed this approval while you were reviewing it. Close and reopen to see the current decision.

disabled.title: Rotating shifts are off
disabled.description: Staff are judged by their fixed schedule. If shifts rotate in your business (open, mid, close), turn them on in Settings.

templates.title: Shifts
templates.description: Your shifts: name, abbreviation, color and hours. Editing one never rewrites weeks already published.
templates.empty: No shifts yet. Create the first one (e.g. “Open 08:00–16:00”).
templates.name: Name
templates.activeHint: Off stops offering it; existing assignments are kept.

week.label: {{from}} – {{to}}
week.noTeam: No active staff in this venue.
week.legend: Dashed border = draft. Once published, the assigned shift overrides the fixed schedule; a vacation or day off captured on the person still wins over everything.

shifts.toastSkipped: {{count}} draft(s) saved by someone else were not published: review them and publish again
shifts.toastConflict: Someone changed a draft this week while you were reviewing it. Reloaded: check the cells and publish again.
